# SpaceDelay - Real-time light speed delay calculator
# https://spacedelay.com

## What this site does
Calculate the current distance and light-speed delay between celestial bodies in our solar system. The distance changes in real-time as planets orbit.

## API
Free public API for developers and AI assistants.

### Endpoint
GET https://spacedelay.com/api/distance?from={body1}&to={body2}

### Supported bodies
- sun (The Sun)
- mercury (Mercury)
- venus (Venus)
- earth (Earth)
- moon (Earth's Moon)
- mars (Mars)
- ceres (Ceres, dwarf planet)

### Example request
GET https://spacedelay.com/api/distance?from=earth&to=mars

### Example response
{
  "from": {"id": "earth", "name": "Earth"},
  "to": {"id": "mars", "name": "Mars"},
  "distance": {
    "km": 355000000,
    "miles": 220600000,
    "au": 2.37,
    "light_years": 0.0000375
  },
  "light_delay": {
    "seconds": 1184,
    "formatted": "19m 44s"
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-02-02T12:00:00.000Z",
  "data_source": "keplerian"
}

### Rate limits
100 requests per day per IP address.

## How to use
To get the current light-speed delay between Earth and Mars:
curl "https://spacedelay.com/api/distance?from=earth&to=mars"

To get Earth to Moon delay:
curl "https://spacedelay.com/api/distance?from=earth&to=moon"

## Data accuracy
Positions calculated using Keplerian orbital elements (~1% accuracy).
Suitable for educational and casual use.
